To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@nebularetail.com
Date: 2026-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: PO issuance + onboarding package for Q3 fulfillment

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking this. We're finalizing our Q3 purchase plan for Nebula Retail and need Redwood to issue the official PO numbers so our ERP can accept invoices. Attached is the completed onboarding form and our preferred line-item breakdown (nebula_line_items_v1.xlsx).

Key items:
- Target spend cap: $120,000 for initial cadence (may be split across two SKUs)
- Preferred billing cadence: net 45; please confirm payment remittance details
- One consolidated PO would be fine but our ledger requires each SKU be represented as separate line items with unique PO refs.

Can you confirm timeframe for issuing PO numbers and whether Redwood can map two PO refs under the same spend cap? Also looping procurement@nebularetail.com for internal tracking.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Procurement Manager
Nebula Retail
Attachments: Nebula_Onboarding_Form_2026-07-24.pdf, nebula_line_items_v1.xlsx
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@nebularetail.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-07-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO issuance + onboarding package for Q3 fulfillment

Hi Samantha — thanks for sending the form and line items. Quick readthrough shows two areas we should clarify before issuing final PO refs:

1) Spend cap vs PO distribution
   - Your note suggests a single $120k cap but separate PO refs per SKU. Our procurement ledger supports grouping multiple PO numbers under one spend cap, but we need to split the spend allocation per PO in our system.

2) Line item SKU mapping (ledger mismatch)
   - The SKUs in nebula_line_items_v1.xlsx use your internal SKU format (NR-XXXX). Our vendor catalog maps to Redwood SKU tokens (RWD-YYYY). We need a 1:1 mapping or a reconciliation file so finance doesn't allocate spend to the wrong ledger codes.

Planner: I'll route this to Ben (vendor activation) and Laura (PO assignments) to propose the PO numbering scheme. Can you confirm whether Nebula prefers:
A) One master PO (PO-NEB-2026-0001) with two internal SKU lines, or
B) Two separate PO numbers (PO-NEB-2026-0001A, PO-NEB-2026-0001B) tied to the same spend cap?

If you prefer option B we'll need a signed confirmation (DocuSign link below) and your ERP contact so we can sync number formats.

Rafael Mendes
Senior Manager, Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-07-27T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: PO issuance + onboarding package for Q3 fulfillment

Rafael / Laura — I pulled the onboarding CSV exports from finance and compared against the nebula spreadsheet. There are three discrepancies we should fix before issuing POs:

- Item mapping: NR-4412 in Nebula maps to RWD-PL-87 in our system, but Nebula expects it broken into two configurable lines (base + premium add-on). Our ledger only had a single line.
- Spend bucket: The $120k cap is fine but Nebula's request includes an early-evaluation credit of $10k which must be tracked as a separate ledger line (credit).
- Line-level rounding: Nebula's unit prices have cents; our PO lines must be whole cents and sometimes generate a rounding difference that causes reconciliation failures in their accounts payable.

Action items I'm proposing:
1) Issue two PO refs (split by SKU) and associate both with a single spend cap record in Redwood so we preserve their ERP expectation while keeping a single cap.
2) Attach an internal PO assignment CSV (rf_po_assignments_20260727.csv) that maps NR SKUs to RWD SKUs and final PO ids. I'll drop the file into the shared onboarding Drive.
3) Request an amended Nebula signature that accepts the $10k evaluation credit as a separate line (keeps accounting clean).

I'll prepare the PO numbers once Laura confirms the final SKU-to-ledger mapping.

Ben Carter
Vendor Activation Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments: rf_po_assignments_20260727.csv
Related: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NeBuLa-Onboard-Docs
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@nebularetail.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-07-29T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Final: PO refs assigned & spend-cap routing (Nebula Retail)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick turnaround. We completed internal reconciliation and have issued two PO numbers to satisfy your ERP and our ledger. Details below and attached:

- PO-NEB-2026-1001A — NR-4412 (base) mapped to RWD-PL-87 — allocated cap: $65,000
- PO-NEB-2026-1001B — NR-4412-PREM (premium add-on) mapped to RWD-PL-87-P — allocated cap: $45,000
- Evaluation credit (separate line): CN-NEB-2026-1001C — credit amount: $10,000 (to be applied to first invoice)

All three PO refs are associated with a single spend cap record in our system (cap id: CAP-NEB-2026-001) so total cap remains $120,000. We've attached the RF assignment CSV and a PDF summary. Please review and sign the DocuSign envelope to finalize: DocuSign: envelopeId=0a1b2c3d4e

Next steps:
- Samantha: please confirm if the PO numbering format is acceptable to your ERP and sign the DocuSign packet.
- Ben: can you push the RF CSV into finance so items map immediately when the first invoice arrives?
- Laura: please update the procurement dashboard with the cap id and PO refs.

Thanks — Rafael

Rafael Mendes
Senior Manager, Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
